voice.hook: Six legends and six guesses. Is it higher or lower? Keep score!
voice.q0: Michael Jordan scored 32,292 career points. Did Kobe Bryant score more, or less?
voice.q1: Walter Payton ran for 16,726 career yards. Did Emmitt Smith run for more, or less?
voice.r1: It's higher! Emmitt's 18,355 are the most ever.
voice.q2: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar scored 38,387 points. Did Karl Malone score more, or less?
voice.q3: Jerry Rice piled up 22,895 receiving yards. Did Larry Fitzgerald catch for more, or less?
voice.r3: It's lower. Fitzgerald finished with 17,492, still second all time.
voice.q4: Wilt Chamberlain grabbed 23,924 career rebounds. Did Bill Russell grab more, or less?
voice.q5: Drew Brees threw 571 touchdown passes. Did Tom Brady throw more, or less?
voice.outro: How many did you get? Comment your score, and follow for more!
